hypothesis: Paired N=256 arm (seeds 62-64, otherwise identical to the N=64 arm). This replicates the e<=0.5 result from seeds 56-58, where N=256 formed later by +20/+70/+30 steps on the 0.1 bar and by +20/+10/+30 on the half-final-margin measure. At e in [0, 0.5], accel_step forms later at N=256 than at N=64 for the same seed.
expected_if_true: Read from trajectories, the N=256 minus N=64 persistent 0.1-bar difference is >= 20 steps in all 3 matched seeds, and the half-final-margin difference is >= 20 steps in at least 2 of 3 seeds.
expected_if_false: The half-final-margin difference is <= 10 steps in at least 2 of 3 matched seeds. Any remaining 0.1-bar gap would then be attributed to lower final margins (control ceiling), not later formation. A mixed result is recorded as inconclusive.
